fact: The Ministry of Digital Transformation officially launched the national internet exchange centre (IXP) at International Mauritanian Telecommunications (IMT) on 2025-05-28 (document gives no city or member count), with a technical presentation of its operation by the head of the Digital Infrastructure Foundation, per Sahara Medias reporting the ministry.
system: Centre national d'échange Internet (national IXP at IMT)

fact: The WARCIP-Mauritania feasibility study (consultants Marpij, Neo Telecoms, Eric Veve; final version, June 2014) states that Mauritania has no exchange point yet: operators' traffic to each other is transit, not local peering, and Dakar in effect acts as the IXP for Mauritanian operators, Mauritel and Chinguitel traffic being exchanged there; the study proposes creating one.
The ministry's representative says the National Internet Exchange Centre (IXP) was recently officially launched, as a local exchange platform to localise data traffic.
The Nouakchott Data Center is stated to provide a central data exchange point linking local and international ISPs and operators.
